name: Earthly Possessions
overview: Scripture warns believers against placing their love and trust in earthly possessions, highlighting that pursuing wealth and abundance ultimately leads to dissatisfaction and vanity, as seen in Ecclesiastes 5:10. Jesus teaches that treasures stored on earth are vulnerable to decay and theft, urging His followers to prioritize seeking God's kingdom and righteousness above material gain (Matthew 6:19, 6:33). The call to discipleship involves a willingness to relinquish earthly goods for heavenly treasures (Matthew 19:21), recognizing that life’s true value is not measured by possessions but by devotion to God rather than mammon (Matthew 6:24; Luke 12:15).
